mapper.select:
/* 설명 : 사용자과목접속목록조회 - 현재시간보다 120분이전 접속기록조회*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT S.SBJCT_ID, S.SBJCTNM, USR.USER_ID, USR.USERNM, O.ORGNM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY LUA.USER_ID ORDER BY LUA.ACTV_DATETIME DESC ) AS RN, NVL(USR.PHOTO_FILE_ID, 'user_img') AS USER_THUMBNAIL
FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV LUA ON LUA.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND LUA.ACTV_DATETIME >= (SYSDATE - NUMTODSINTERVAL( 120, 'MINUTE')) JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = LUA.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = SC.ORG_ID WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY USERNM

/* 설 명 : 현재강의주차일정조회 */ SELECT LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID, LCTR_WKNO, LCTR_WKNO_SYMD || '000000' LCTR_WKNO_SYMD , LCTR_WKNO_EYMD || '000000' LCTR_WKNO_EYMD FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL LWS WHERE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN LWS.LCTR_WKNO_SYMD AND LWS.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD AND LWS.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND LWS.DELYN = 'N' AND ROWNUM = 1

/* 설 명 : 중간고사기말고사조회 */ SELECT SO.SBJCT_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN EB.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' THEN ED.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM END) AS MID_EXAM_SDTTM , MAX(CASE WHEN EB.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' THEN ED.EXAM_MNTS END) AS MID_EXAM_MNTS , MAX(CASE WHEN EB.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_LST' THEN ED.EXAM_PSBL_SDTTM END) AS LST_EXAM_SDTTM , MAX(CASE WHEN EB.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_LST' THEN ED.EXAM_MNTS END) AS LST_EXAM_MNTS FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SO JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC EB ON EB.SBJCT_ID = SO.SBJCT_ID AND EB.DELYN = 'N' AND EB.USEYN = 'Y' AND ( EB.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' OR EB.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_LST') JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL ED ON EB.EXAM_BSC_ID = ED.EXAM_BSC_ID AND ED.DELYN = 'N' AND ED.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1 AND SO.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} GROUP BY SO.SBJCT_ID

/* 설 명 : 과목조회 */ SELECT SBJCT.* , ORG.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , ORG.ORG_TYCD , SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON SMSTR.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID WHERE SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* 설 명 : 과목게시판아이디조회*/ SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'NTC' THEN BBS.BBS_ID END) AS NTC_BBS_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = '1ON1' THEN BBS.BBS_ID END) AS ONE_ON_ONE_BBS_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'QNA' THEN BBS.BBS_ID END) AS QNA_BBS_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'DATARM' THEN BBS.BBS_ID END) AS DATARM_BBS_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN TB_LMS_BBS BBS ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = BBS.SBJCT_ID AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' WHERE SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* 설 명 : 과목관리자조회 */ SELECT A.SBJCT_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN A.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF' THEN U.USERNM END) AS PROFNM, MAX(CASE WHEN A.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'COPROF' THEN U.USERNM END) AS COPROFNM, MAX(CASE WHEN A.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'TUT' THEN U.USERNM END) AS TUTNM, MAX(CASE WHEN A.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'ASSI' THEN U.USERNM END) AS ASSINM FROM FURLMS.TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM A JOIN FURLMS.TB_LMS_USER U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.SBJCT_ADM_SEQNO = 1 GROUP BY A.SBJCT_ID ORDER BY A.SBJCT_ID

/* SQL ID : SubjectDAO.sbjctAdmList 설 명 : 과목관리자목록조회 */ SELECT ADM.SBJCT_ID , ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD , ADM.USER_ID , USR.USERNM , DEPT.DEPTNM , NVL(CNTCT.HOME_PHN, '-') AS HOME_PHN , NVL(CNTCT.MBL_PHN , '-') AS MBL_PHN , NVL(CNTCT.OFFI_PHN, '-') AS OFFI_PHN , NVL( CASE WHEN USR.USE_EML_GBNCD = 'INDV' OR USR.USE_EML_GBNCD IS NULL THEN CNTCT.INDV_EML WHEN USR.USE_EML_GBNCD = 'LNKG' THEN CNTCT.LNKG_EML END , '-') AS EML , NVL(USR.PHOTO_FILE_ID, 'user_img') AS USER_THUMBNAIL FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = ADM.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN CNTCT_TYCD = 'HOME_PHN' THEN CNTCT END) AS HOME_PHN , MAX(CASE WHEN CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' THEN CNTCT END) AS MBL_PHN , MAX(CASE WHEN CNTCT_TYCD = 'OFFI_PHN' THEN CNTCT END) AS OFFI_PHN , MAX(CASE WHEN CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' THEN CNTCT END) AS INDV_EML , MAX(CASE WHEN CNTCT_TYCD = 'LNKG_EML' THEN CNTCT END) AS LNKG_EML FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT CNTCT GROUP BY USER_ID ) CNTCT ON CNTCT.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID WHERE ADM.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ORDER BY CASE ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD WHEN 'PROF' THEN 1 WHEN 'TUT' THEN 2 WHEN 'ASSI' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END , USR.USERNM

/* 설 명 : 과목학습활동조회 */ SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(ATCL.ATCL_ID) FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL ATCL ON BBS.BBS_ID = ATCL.BBS_ID AND ATCL.DELYN = 'N' WHERE BBS.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'NTC' ) AS NTC_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(ATCL.ATCL_ID) FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL ATCL ON BBS.BBS_ID = ATCL.BBS_ID AND ATCL.DELYN = 'N' WHERE BBS.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = 'QNA' AND ATCL.UP_ATCL_ID IS NULL ) AS QNA_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(ATCL.ATCL_ID) FROM TB_LMS_BBS BBS JOIN TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL ATCL ON BBS.BBS_ID = ATCL.BBS_ID AND ATCL.DELYN = 'N' WHERE BBS.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND BBS.DELYN = 'N' AND BBS.BBS_TYCD = '1ON1' AND ATCL.UP_ATCL_ID IS NULL ) AS ONEONONE_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(SBJCT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT WHERE ASMT.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND ASMT.DELYN = 'N' ) AS ASMT_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(SBJCT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS DSCS WHERE DSCS.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND DSCS.DELYN = 'N' ) AS DSCS_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(SBJCT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_SMNR SMNR WHERE SMNR.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND SMNR.DELYN = 'N' AND SMNR.UP_SMNR_ID IS NULL ) AS SMNR_CNT ,( SELECT COUNT(SBJCT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY WHERE SRVY.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL ) AS SRVY_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(SBJCT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC WHERE BSC.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND BSC.DELYN='N' AND BSC.USEYN='Y' AND BSC.EXAM_TYCD='QUIZ' ) AS QUIZ_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(SBJCT_ID) FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC BSC WHERE BSC.SBJCT_ID = SA.SBJCT_ID AND BSC.DELYN='N' AND BSC.USEYN='Y'AND BSC.EXAM_TYCD='EXAM' ) AS EXAM_CNT FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SA WHERE SA.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* 설명 : 과목운영자권한조회 ID : SubjectDAO.subjectByAdmAuthSelect */ SELECT A.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD AS AUTH FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM A, TB_LMS_SBJCT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* 설명 : 과목수강생권한조회 ID : SubjectDAO.subjectByStdntAuthSelect */ SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'STDNT' END AS AUTH FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A, TB_LMS_SBJCT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.SBJCT_ID = B.SBJCT_ID AND A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND A.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* 설명 : 교수자 운영과목 전체 조회 ID : SubjectDAO.subjectListAllByProf */ SELECT ORG.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , SMSTR.DGRS_YR , SMSTR.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT , SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRTNM , ADM.SBJCT_ADM_TYCD AS SBJCT_AUTH , SBJCT.* FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM ADM ON ADM.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND ADM.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON SMSTR.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY ORG.ORG_ID ASC, SMSTR.DGRS_YR DESC, SMSTR.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT DESC, SBJCT.SBJCTNM ASC

/* 설명 : 학생 수강과목 전체 조회 ID : subjectListAllByStdnt */ SELECT ORG.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID , SMSTR.DGRS_YR , SMSTR.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT , SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRTNM , 'STDNT' AS SBJCT_AUTH , SBJCT.* FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SMSTR ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = SMSTR.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON SMSTR.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY ORG.ORG_ID ASC, SMSTR.DGRS_YR DESC, SMSTR.DGRS_SMSTR_CHRT DESC, SBJCT.SBJCTNM ASC
